description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for a payment method selection bottom sheet. It allows users to choose from Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, or Cash, and attempts to launch the respective payment apps via deep links.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides a bottom sheet UI for selecting payment methods with deep link launching capabilities.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment method sheet, including UI components for each payment option.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Helper method that creates a ListTile for a payment method, customized with icon, name, color, and tap behavior.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch the specified payment app deep link; shows a snackbar error if the app isn't installed.
